why: reviewer (minor): The Devanagari is दैवाेपघात: the o-matra is printed as ā-matra + e-matra (a typographic split of ो), so IAST daivāepaghāta is a mechanical rendering and the reading daivopaghāta is essentially what is printed, not a garbled guess. The real conjecture is mamo -> mano (ममो). The "conjectural reading" hedge in the translations can stay (mano), but the flag why should say this.
